Current is 0.5+0.5+1.0 uA plus ~0.1 uA start-up, about 4 uW. The weak-PMOS/NMOS inverter start-up kicks the zero-current state."}

PARAMS = {
    "Icore":  (0.5e-6, 0.25e-6, 0.8e-6),   # per-branch core current [A]
    "Vptat":  (0.22, 0.15, 0.27),          # PTAT voltage across R2 at 27C [V]
    "gmid_n": (22.0, 16.0, 26.0),          # weak-inversion NMOS pair
    "Ln":     (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),
    "gmid_p": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),           # PMOS mirror
    "Lp":     (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "Cf":     (1e-12, 0.2e-12, 4e-12),     # pg-to-vdd filter cap (PSRR)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    K = 8            # M2:M1 width ratio
    MOUT = 2         # Iout = 2*Icore
    Ic = p["Icore"]
    Iout = MOUT * Ic

    # NMOS pair: M1 diode, M2 = K x M1, degenerated by R1
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], Ic, vds=0.55)
    dvgs = math.log(K) / m1.gm_id            # n*UT*ln(K) in weak inversion
    R1 = dvgs / Ic

    # PMOS mirror (same L and gm/Id); output device scaled 2x via m
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Ic, vds=1.0)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Ic, vds=1.0)

    R2 = p["Vptat"] / Iout

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # branch 1: PMOS M4 -> NMOS diode M1
    n.dev("M4", "ng", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M1", "ng", "ng", "vss", "vss", m1)
    # branch 2: PMOS diode M3 -> NMOS M2 (K x) -> R1
    n.dev("M3", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.M("M2", "pg", "ng", "sr", "vss", "nfet", m1.W * K, p["Ln"], m=K)
    n.R("R1", "sr", "vss", R1)
    # output branch: 2x PMOS mirror -> R2 -> PNP
    n.M("M5", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", m3.W * MOUT, p["Lp"], m=MOUT)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e", R2)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e", m=1)
    # supply-tracking cap on PMOS gate improves PSRR
    n.C("Cf", "pg", "vdd", p["Cf"])

    # start-up: weak PMOS pull-up (gate = vref, so it is strong only while vref ~ 0),
    # NMOS pull-down mirrored from ng, kick device Ms1 from pg to ng
    n.M("Mpu1", "su1", "vref", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("Mpu2", "su", "vref", "su1", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("Mpd", "su", "ng", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 4.0, 1.0)
    n.M("Ms1", "pg", "su", "ng", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)

    # predictions
    veb = 0.76 + UT * math.log(Iout / 10e-6)
    dveb = -(1.17 + 3 * UT - veb) / 300.15
    vref = veb + p["Vptat"]
    slope = dveb + p["Vptat"] / 300.15
    tc = abs(slope) / vref * 1e6
    Isu = 0.1e-6
    power = 1.98 * (2 * Ic + Iout + Isu) * (398.0 / 300.0)   # worst case: 125C, high VDD
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "line_reg": 0.03,
               "power": power, "psrr_1k": 30.0, "startup_ok": 1}
